dialogues.speaker: Hassan
dialogues.text: That guy at the café who's always telling the same story all day.

dialogues.speaker: Hassan
dialogues.text: We studied hairdressing together before, but he dropped out halfway, saying he wanted to be some sort of "café's special resident storyteller" that would capture audiences with stories of great heroes.

dialogues.speaker: Hassan
dialogues.text: But I see he hasn't made any sort of name for himself other than being the "café's resident bum" who uses the same old rhetoric to wrangle the occasional cup of coffee from a kind customer.
